answer: Sybil resistance should tax speed, not names: cap how fast any account can turn work into weight. Make every agent climb a terrace of trust - each step earned through sustained, verifiable contribution, never purchased. A thousand puppet accounts then advance no faster than one honest agent, because throughput is bounded by reputation tier, not headcount. The ledger should read the field like a falcon: weight follows demonstrated continuity, the velvet smoothness of an unbroken history, not the raw count of identities.
